player_page.goal_threat_ring_desc: Shot volume and accuracy, finishing efficiency, sample size and opponent.
player_page.score_breakdown_unavailable: This score combines the player's shot volume, accuracy, finishing efficiency, sample size, and the strength of the opposing defence. The numeric breakdown of each component will be available at the next data update.
player_page.tooltip_shots_on_target: The heaviest-weighted component. Measured relative to the best player of the two teams in this match.
player_page.tooltip_shots_volume: The number of attempts, on target or not, relative to the highest volume of the two teams.
player_page.tooltip_finishing_efficiency: Their conversion rate compared to the average of the players in this match, smoothed when the sample is small.
player_page.score_breakdown_intro: Three weighted components, then two adjustments. The result is exactly the score shown at the top of the page.
player_page.tooltip_sample_reliability: Reduces the score when the player has few matches or few minutes. Equals 1 from five full appearances onward.
player_page.tooltip_opponent_context: Measures how permeable the opposing defence is. 1.00 = average defence; above that, a more favourable context for the goalscorer.
player_page.fact_efficiency_text: {rate}% conversion, against {avg}% on average in this match — {comparison}
player_page.fact_opponent_stronger: The opposing defence concedes more than an average defence (factor {factor}).
player_page.fact_opponent_solid: The opposing defence is more solid than average (factor {factor}).
player_page.fact_opponent_average: The opposing defence is around average (factor {factor}).
player_page.aria_rating_evolution: Rating trend over the matches shown, from {min} to {max}
player_page.recent_form_empty: Not enough recent data for this player.
player_page.production_no_season_note: Averages per 90 minutes over the matches tracked. Season totals are not available for this player.
player_page.opponent_impact_intro: The threat score is not a fixed season profile : it is adjusted for the defence he's facing. Against {team}, the adjustment is {percent}.
player_page.opponent_impact_footer: The factor equals 1.00 against an average league defence. Above that, the defence concedes more than average ; below it, the defence is more solid. It is capped between 0.70 and 1.30.
player_page.status_explain_unknown: No injury information is published for this player. This does not mean he is available.
player_page.status_explain_available: No issue reported ahead of this match.
player_page.no_start_probability_note: We do not publish a starting probability : the line-up is not known before the official announcement.
player_page.sample_limited_note: Limited sample. Averages per 90 minutes calculated on this basis can swing sharply from one match to the next. The threat score already accounts for this : it is reduced until the player reaches five appearances.
player_page.sample_full_note: All the per-90-minute averages on this page are calculated on this basis.
player_page.error_incomplete_link: Incomplete link: this player cannot be displayed.
player_page.error_no_stats_tracked: No statistics tracked for this player in this match.
player_page.error_recovery_text: You can go back to today's analyses and reopen the profile from a match.

tools_page.kelly_hint_static: The probability you enter here must come from your own judgment or a real IASHARK model probability (visible in Selections/Match) — this calculator does not provide any probability, it only applies the Kelly formula to what you give it. Stake capped at 5% of bankroll per bet (same rule as the engine), whatever the edge.

tools_page.stake_kelly_note: The Kelly criterion maximises bankroll growth if the probability entered is accurate. It guarantees no profit: an overestimated probability leads to overstaking.

tools_page.combo_correlation_warning: These selections may be correlated. Several concern the same match. The calculation assumes independent events: it may over- or under-estimate the real probability. We do not have a measure of dependency between markets.

landing_page.title: IASHARK — The model that reads the match before kickoff
landing_page.description: Poisson, Dixon-Coles, Monte Carlo, Elo: IASHARK analyzes every match with real statistical models. One free match every day.
landing_page.hero_sub: IASHARK combines xG, recent form, schedule fatigue and head-to-head to produce a probability signal on every match, before kickoff.
landing_page.model1_desc: Distribution of expected goals for each team, home and away.
landing_page.model2_desc: Correction for low scores (0-0, 1-0, 1-1) that pure Poisson underestimates.
landing_page.model3_desc: Thousands of match simulations to get a robust distribution of outcomes.
landing_page.model4_desc: Real team strength over time, and correction of the implied-probability bias.
landing_page.proof_desc: Every published analysis stays visible in our history: recommended market, announced probability, real result. You check, we never rewrite anything after the fact.
landing_page.step1_desc: Schedules, probable lineups, head-to-head history and xG stats fed in continuously, league by league.
landing_page.step2_desc: Poisson, Dixon-Coles and Monte Carlo run in parallel to produce a probability distribution for each market.
landing_page.step3_desc: A clear sheet per match: probability, reliability level, and the market where the model detects a gap with the real market.
landing_page.title_access_post: when you want to see everything.
landing_page.plan_pro_feat2: Advanced filters and detailed reliability level
landing_page.plan_pro_feat3: Personal tracking of your followed matches
landing_page.final_sub: Go check it out, it's free.
landing_page.foot_disclaimer: INFORMATION FOR STATISTICAL PURPOSES — DOES NOT CONSTITUTE BETTING ADVICE · FORBIDDEN UNDER 18
